segments.vv73:1.3: Āmuttahatthābharaṇo yasassī, dibbe vimānamhi yathāpi candimā.
segments.vv73:2.1: “Dibbā ca vīṇā pavadanti vagguṃ, aṭṭhaṭṭhakā sikkhitā sādhurūpā;
segments.vv73:2.3: Dibbā ca kaññā tidasacarā uḷārā, naccanti gāyanti pamodayanti.
segments.vv73:3.3: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv73:4.1: So devaputto attamano … pe … yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.vv73:5.3: Sampannavijjācaraṇe yasassī, bahussute sīlavante pasanne [sīlavatūpapanne (ka. sī. ka.)];
segments.vv73:5.5: Annañca pānañca pasannacitto, sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adāsiṃ.
segments.vv73:6.1: “Tena metādiso vaṇṇo … pe … vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
